<svg viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" width="1920" height="1080">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="vig" cx="55%" cy="45%" r="75%">
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0.7"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="signShadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="130%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="10" dy="16" stdDeviation="10" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.55"/>
    </filter>
    <pattern id="corr" width="14" height="14" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(90)">
      <rect width="14" height="14" fill="none"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="7" x2="14" y2="7" stroke="#8a6436" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.18"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
  <image href="/assets/titles/neil-cooking.jpg" xlink:href="/assets/titles/neil-cooking.jpg" x="0" y="0" width="1920" height="1080" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>
  <rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="url(#vig)"/>

  <!-- the sign: a torn flap off a box, taped to the wall -->
  <g transform="rotate(-5 380 330)" filter="url(#signShadow)">
    <path d="M78,92 L132,84 L170,96 L246,82 L330,90 L402,80 L486,92 L560,84 L652,96 L668,170 L660,262 L672,350 L662,452 L670,548 L604,560 L520,552 L432,564 L350,554 L262,566 L180,556 L96,566 L86,470 L94,372 L82,276 L92,182 Z"
      fill="#b88c57" stroke="#6b4a25" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M78,92 L132,84 L170,96 L246,82 L330,90 L402,80 L486,92 L560,84 L652,96 L668,170 L660,262 L672,350 L662,452 L670,548 L604,560 L520,552 L432,564 L350,554 L262,566 L180,556 L96,566 L86,470 L94,372 L82,276 L92,182 Z" fill="url(#corr)"/>
    <!-- a coffee ring, because it was a coaster first -->
    <circle cx="590" cy="480" r="46" fill="none" stroke="#6b4a25" stroke-width="5" opacity="0.28"/>

    <!-- the name the church would have liked, crossed out -->
    <text x="375" y="176" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Impact', 'Arial Black', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif" font-size="66" fill="#2a2018" letter-spacing="3">DAILY BREAD</text>
    <path d="M150,146 C260,136 420,158 604,140" stroke="#c0281e" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.88"/>
    <path d="M156,158 C300,168 470,144 598,162" stroke="#c0281e" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>

    <!-- what it is -->
    <path d="M128,372 C260,356 470,384 628,362 L626,400 C470,416 262,392 130,410 Z" fill="#ffe070" opacity="0.8"/>
    <text x="378" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Impact', 'Arial Black', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif" font-size="124" fill="#1c1610" letter-spacing="4">COOKING</text>
    <text x="378" y="440" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Impact', 'Arial Black', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif" font-size="164" fill="#1c1610" letter-spacing="10">SHIT</text>

    <!-- his name on a strip of masking tape -->
    <g transform="rotate(3 380 500)">
      <rect x="150" y="462" width="460" height="64" fill="#efe4bf" opacity="0.94"/>
      <path d="M150,462 l-8,10 l8,10 l-8,10 l8,10 l-8,10 l8,14 M610,462 l8,10 l-8,10 l8,10 l-8,10 l8,10 l-8,14" fill="none" stroke="#efe4bf" stroke-width="3"/>
      <text x="380" y="506" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Impact', 'Arial Black', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif" font-size="38" fill="#2a2018" letter-spacing="2">with Neil McManistan</text>
    </g>

    <!-- tape at the top corners -->
    <rect x="62" y="64" width="120" height="40" fill="#efe4bf" opacity="0.85" transform="rotate(-24 122 84)"/>
    <rect x="596" y="70" width="120" height="40" fill="#efe4bf" opacity="0.85" transform="rotate(20 656 90)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- the stream's own tag, bottom left -->
  <g>
    <rect x="56" y="972" width="712" height="58" rx="6" fill="#0c0c0c" opacity="0.72"/>
    <circle cx="92" cy="1001" r="12" fill="#e0281e"/>
    <text x="118" y="1012" font-family="'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="bold" fill="#f2f2f2" letter-spacing="2">LIVE</text>
    <text x="206" y="1012" font-family="'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="27" fill="#d8d8d8">St Garneau's basement, on the priest's WiFi</text>
  </g>
</svg>
description: Neil McManistan in St Garneau's basement kitchen, rendered from his 3D figure, under a cardboard sign with DAILY BREAD crossed out and COOKING SHIT written over it.
name: Cooking Shit: title card
